title: Current Codex Cloud Security inventory is inaccessible for Framework reconciliation
title_de: Aktuelles Codex-Cloud-Security-Inventar für die Framework-Reconciliation ist nicht erreichbar
technical_claim: The requested reconciliation requires the current Codex Cloud Security scan and every Cloud finding's metadata. The active session exposes neither a Codex Cloud finding/scan inventory nor a scan trigger/status/closure operation, and the documented Codex Cloud UI redirects this session to ChatGPT login.
entry_point: Codex Cloud Security service integration for Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: The task can inspect local Framework source and independent GitHub CodeQL/code-scanning data, but there is no authenticated Codex Cloud service path from which Cloud IDs, scan revision, finding evidence, or closure capabilities can be obtained.
observed_behavior: The exact Framework master and GitHub security data are readable, but Codex Cloud scan SHA, scan time/status, Cloud finding inventory, and Cloud closure functions are absent from the active tool surface and retained evidence. Direct documented Findings and Scans UI access redirects this session to ChatGPT login.
expected_behavior: A reconciliation session must be able to read the current Codex Cloud scan and finding metadata and, where authorized, request a new scan and apply evidence-backed Cloud dispositions.
impact: No Cloud finding can be mapped, revalidated, fixed, or closed with adequate evidence. Treating CodeQL or an older user-visible scan hint as a substitute would create false closure claims.
preconditions: The task requires current Codex Cloud Security evidence for the Framework repository.
A Codex Cloud export, UI handoff, or authenticated API connector has not been supplied to this session.
reproduction: Inspect the active callable tool surface for Codex Cloud Security scan/finding/status/closure operations.
Run the Codex Security local capability preflight and distinguish its local-workflow readiness from Cloud service access.
Query GitHub code-scanning alerts and analyses and confirm that their CodeQL results do not contain Codex Cloud finding IDs or scan metadata.
legitimate_control: GitHub CodeQL analyses and code-scanning alerts remain separately readable and must continue to be reported as GitHub evidence, not as Codex Cloud evidence.
bypass_review: No safe bypass exists: guessing Cloud IDs, treating the stale fa1a7440 prefix as current, relabelling CodeQL as Codex Cloud, or closing a finding without the Cloud service would violate the user request and security/finding policies.
root_cause: The active environment lacks an authenticated Codex Cloud Security connector/API/UI handoff. A direct documented UI attempt confirmed that the session is not authenticated to the required ChatGPT workspace; no retained export contains the requested current Cloud finding metadata.
proposed_remediation: Use an authenticated Codex Cloud Security workspace session with repository/environment access for this repository and current default branch, or export the completed scan bundle and findings JSON/CSV/SARIF from that session. Resume from the exact Framework master after recording scan revision and evidence.
fix: No Framework source or CI change is appropriate. The required remediation is authenticated Cloud-workspace access or an authoritative Cloud export.
acceptance_criteria: An authoritative current Codex Cloud scan SHA, time, and terminal status are available for Framework master.
Every visible Cloud finding has ID, title, severity, rule/detector, location, evidence, and status available for mapping.
A new exact-master Cloud scan can be requested or its unavailability is attributed to an authenticated Cloud-service response.
Cloud closure capabilities and allowed disposition reasons are visible before any closure is attempted.
validation_plan: Re-run scan-freshness and finding inventory retrieval after Cloud access is supplied.
Map each Cloud ID to an existing or new FND-FRAMEWORK record and synchronize EN/DE/JSON/index/backlog/roadmap.
Revalidate all confirmed findings on the exact final Framework master scan before Cloud/local closure.
legitimate_control_tests: Read GitHub CodeQL/code-scanning results without calling them Codex Cloud results.
dependencies: Authenticated Codex Cloud Security workspace/UI or service/API export
Current scan and finding metadata for Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework
